svg.title: Mapping a Business Process to Copilot
svg.desc: Step 1: list all tasks in the process. Step 2: classify each task as automatable, augmentable, judgment-heavy or relationship-based. Step 3: prioritise automatable and augmentable tasks for the fastest ROI. Step 4: map each to a Copilot feature such as Teams, Excel, Chat or an agent.
svg.text: Mapping a Business Process to Copilot
Four steps from task list to Copilot feature; start where ROI is fastest.
